name: TC-DA — Student updates DA form data after having previously submitted a DA application

steps.name: Log in as the student and record an IELTS result on the DA application form
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Direct Apply', exact: true }).or(getByRole('heading', { name: 'What is Direct Apply?', exact: true }))
Expect "toHaveCount" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Direct Apply', exact: true }).or(getByRole('heading', { name: 'What is Direct Apply?', exact: true }))
Click locator('tbody tr').filter({ hasText: 'University of New South Wales' }).getByText('Complete application', { exact: true })

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().getByText('Fill Form Manually', { exact: true }).or(getByText('Complete your Application', { exact: true })).or(getByText('Application Sections', { exact: true })).or(getByRole('heading', { name: 'Review your application' })).or(getByText('Submitted for Counsellor Review', { exact: true }))
Query count locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().getByText('Fill Form Manually', { exact: true }).or(getByText('Complete your Application', { exact: true }))
Click locator('#da-application-form-iframe').contentFrame().getByText('Fill Form Manually', { exact: true }).or(getByText('Complete your Application', { exact: true })).first()
Update the IELTS score in the platform Student Profile Test Scores section
Wait for selector locator('app-confirmation-modal')
